sql: SELECT round(avg(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28'), 4) AS value, round(avg(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE NOT (o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28')), 4) AS baseline, (SELECT round(stddev_samp(m), 4) FROM (SELECT avg(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS m FROM orders.orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-04-30' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04' AND NOT (o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28') GROUP BY floor(date_diff('day', DATE '2018-04-30', CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE)) / 7))) AS spread, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28') AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28')) AS n_baseline FROM orders.orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-04-30' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
